notes:
ACCEPTANCE BASELINE STUDY — Actual three-bay casework and two source-sized cut rod envelopes; socket engagement, supports, shelf holes, anchors and measured obstructions remain incomplete.

Closet insert — PARTIAL DIMENSIONAL STUDY
Unresolved: closet-supports: Shelf pins/holes, carcass joints, rod sockets/supports, anti-tip anchors and substrate-dependent fastening schedules remain unspecified.
Unresolved: closet-obstacles: Baseboards, trim, door swings, wall/stud locations and access clearances need measured obstacle geometry.
Unresolved: closet-loads: Shelf/rod spans, panel grade, loads and anchoring are not qualified by this casework geometry.
Unresolved: material.caseworkPanels.installation: Dry interior cabinets, shelving and furniture using the selected BC sanded panel; nominal23/32 category uses reviewed .703-inch actual design thickness. Measure the purchased sheet and confirm panel stamp/grade before precision joinery; .703 inches is not .75 inches and manufacturer size tolerances still apply. This qualification is restricted to dry interior casework. Conflicting exposure descriptions do not establish wet-location, exterior, sauna or structural-seat suitability. The historical Lowe’s offer is retired; do not present it as a purchasable counterpart or import inventory for it.
Unresolved: material.closetRod.installation: Hanging-clothes rod envelope. One 96-inch stock unit; measure before cutting. Dry-fit the delivered rod and sockets, measure both setbacks and insertion clearance, and confirm intermediate support, backing, fasteners and hanging load for your installation.
Unresolved: material.closetRodSupport.installation: Review Everbilt 311V end sockets for the delivered rod and confirm backing, fasteners and any intermediate supports before installation.
Unresolved: closet-rod-end-allowances: The modeled clear openings are provisional lengths. Use the measured opening, socket setbacks and insertion clearance to calculate each cut. Confirm mounting, height, access and intermediate supports.
